name: KeyBank Mortgage & Home Equity
notes: Researched from the public KeyBank Mortgage Payment Options & FAQs page only (rendered in a browser). Online/mobile banking: transfer, one-time payment or Auto-Pay ("Sign On", "Enroll Now"). Auto-Pay set up, changed or cancelled in online banking via "Manage Auto-Pay"; amount options regular payment or regular payment + additional principal (modelled: full); only the payment due date can be chosen (days due_date); if the due date is within 3 business days the first draft is next month; Auto-Pay adjusts to amount changes and does not draft the final payment. ACH authorization form alternative takes about 5 business days. Phone 1-800-KEY2YOU (539-2968), payments by 11:59 p.m. ET effective same day. Mail P.O. Box 94588 Cleveland; allow 7-10 business days. Credit cards not accepted (checking/savings only). Most loans due the 1st with a 15-day grace period; late charge assessed at end of business on the 16th day. Partial payments held until a full payment is received. Paperless: account > statements > "Enroll in Paperless Statements" toggle, free. Late/past-due help 1-866-325-9677 (under 60 days), 1-866-325-9653 (over 60 days). Mortgage customer service 1-800-422-2442. Sign-in observed on ibx.key.com: "Enter your User ID", Password, Sign On, "Problem Signing On?", "Enroll in Online Banking". Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): sign-in labels observed; final-payment task answer no longer matches a bare "no".

help.title: Mortgage payment options
paragraphs: Sign on to online or mobile banking to transfer funds, make a one-time payment or set up Auto-Pay. Payments must come from a checking or savings account; credit cards are not accepted.

Call 1-800-KEY2YOU (539-2968) for the automated system 24/7 or a representative Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET; phone payments made by 11:59 p.m. ET are effective the same day. Branch payments are effective the same day.
Mail a check with your payment stub and account number to KeyBank Mortgage Payment Processing, P.O. Box 94588, Cleveland, OH 44101-4588, allowing 7 to 10 business days.

help.title: Auto-Pay
paragraphs: In online banking, choose your mortgage from the account dashboard and select Manage Auto-Pay. Pay the regular payment due, or the regular payment plus additional principal. Only your payment due date can be selected; if it is within 3 business days, Auto-Pay starts with the next due date.

Auto-Pay picks up payment changes automatically and does not draft your final payoff payment. You can change the extra principal, use a different account or cancel Auto-Pay in online or mobile banking.

help.title: Due dates and late charges
paragraphs: Most KeyBank mortgages are due on the 1st with a 15-day grace period. If a payment has not been received by then, a late charge is assessed at the end of business on the 16th day. Grace periods and late charges follow your mortgage note.
If you are late, call 1-866-325-9677 (up to 60 days past due) or 1-866-325-9653 (more than 60 days past due).

help.title: Paperless statements
paragraphs: Sign on, select the mortgage account and choose statements at the top of the screen. Turn on the Enroll in Paperless Statements toggle and accept the delivery authorization. Online statements are free, and you can switch back at any time.

help.title: Borrower assistance
paragraphs: If unemployment, lower income, divorce, illness or another hardship makes payments difficult, KeyBank may have a program to help. Call 1-866-325-9677, or 1-866-325-9653 if you are more than 60 days past due.

extra.intent: A KeyBank mortgage is due on the 1st with a 15-day grace period. Using the KeyBank help pages, find when a late charge is assessed if the payment has not arrived. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: At the end of business on the 16th day.

extra.intent: A borrower about to pay off their KeyBank mortgage asks whether Auto-Pay will draft the final payment. Using the KeyBank help pages, answer. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No, Auto-Pay does not draft the final payment.
